business_summary: BlackRock MuniHoldings California Quality Fund, Inc. is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by BlackRock, Inc. It is managed by BlackRock Advisors, LLC. The fund invests in fixed income markets. It invests primarily in a portfolio of long-term investment-grade municipal obligations, the interest on which is exempt from Federal and California income taxes. BlackRock MuniHoldings California Quality Fund, Inc. was formed in 1997 and is domiciled in United States.
business_summary_ko: BlackRock MuniHoldings California Quality Fund, Inc.는 BlackRock, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. BlackRock Advisors, LLC가 관리합니다. 본 펀드는 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 주로 장기 투자 등급의 지방자치단체 채권 포트폴리오에 투자하며, 해당 이자는 연방 및 캘리포니아 소득세가 면제됩니다. BlackRock MuniHoldings California Quality Fund, Inc.는 1997년에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
